external_observation_process_evidence.source: Ojanen et al. 2013 Ecology and Evolution, Long-term metapopulation study, doi:10.1002/ece3.733
external_observation_process_evidence.controls: 2008 resurveyed 67 meadows, 2009 180 meadows, 2011 80 meadows; typical individual larval group detection 0.5-0.6. Among meadows deemed empty by initial survey in specific 2009/2011 control re-search, 28 percent later contained nests.
external_observation_process_evidence.separation: Nest detection rate 0.5-0.6 is not patch-level false-negative probability; 28 percent in controls cannot be transferred as probability of hidden positive in every historical zero patch
external_observation_process_evidence.independent_calibration: No per-patch posterior source probability permitted from these literature summaries alone

fixed_target_rule: t positive, t-1 recorded zero, valid t-1 host plant scores, mapped patch centroid; no inference of true colonization
fixed_sources: t-1 recorded positives with valid source-year host scores and coordinates
latent_candidate_pool: t-1 recorded zeros (not missing visits) with valid host scores and coordinate; may be false-negative occupied patches OR genuinely empty; never assign their true state

latent_candidate_subsets.rule: any t-1 measured zero with host+coordinate
t-1 measured zero AND same patch measured positive at t-2

same_patch_cases.rule: latent at target itself admissible, represents persistence/no movement rather than immigration
latent at target itself excluded, represents a conservative different-patch source hypothesis

interpretation: source augmentation is a different assumption axis than distance relaxation and a post-exposure optimization over target geometry, not empirical evidence of undetected occupancy

estimands.baseline_coverage: eligible target count reached by at least one t-1 positive source within declared r and host tolerance
estimands.max_coverage_all_candidates: upper bound if every zero-observed eligible candidate were actually an occupied source
estimands.best_single_hidden_source: EXACT maximum number of currently uncovered targets rescued by one latent candidate chosen retrospectively
estimands.greedy_5_or_10: FEASIBLE, not globally optimal set-cover coverage from sequential max uncovered gain; no claim of globally minimal required number
estimands.unrescued: targets not locally covered at radius even after declared selected candidates; retained as true positive records
estimands.witness: counts only; no candidate source IDs, coordinates, target IDs or biological movement paths exported

test_gates: sha256-verified original two archives; same 2019 km-to-m correction and 2017 coordinate gate; no change to source data
reproduce 12 original t-1/t-2 panel target/source counts, 48 strict radii and unsupported counts against main; fail closed on mismatch
coverage monotone in source budget and radius and host-gap tolerance and eligible candidate set
best-one coverage independently verified by exhaustive candidate enumeration, greedy is explicitly a heuristic beyond one
newly eligible latent candidate cannot be an observed positive t-1, must be an actual recorded zero with measurable habitat
own-patch latent source always labelled persistence-compatible and never interpreted as immigrant
no inferred probabilities from 2013 published detectability values
no p-values, ecological mechanism classification or new EOG-WF endpoint
frozen 3 scored/31 scientific STOP/3 administrative exclusion denominator unchanged
analysis_status: post-exposure sensitivity; not independent ecological validation
